title: Taisei Launches $150 Million AI, Robotics Fund With Pegasus Tech Ventures
summary: Taisei Corp. is bankrolling a $150 million fund to invest in AI and robotics startups, an effort by the 153-year-old Japanese construction company to find technological workarounds for a shrinking workforce.

title: Tesla Cybercab orders open at $29,990 + $299/mo, only in Robotaxi zones
summary: Tesla is now inviting “select customers” to buy a Cybercab for personal use at $29,990, but the car won’t move unless you also pay $299 a month for an “Autonomy Subscription.” And it only works inside Tesla’s Robotaxi service areas in Texas and Florida, the same geofences that have turned out to be significantly smaller than what Tesla advertises. more…

title: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home
summary: Eric Trump-backed robot startup Foundation Future Industries has run low on cash and missed payroll, as CEO Sankaet Pathak faces scrutiny over a $4.6 million company loan.
